cue: An FEI proof claims a dimension-free bound on restriction entropy drop for every coordinate, or infers general failure from one bad split.
fire_when: A candidate FEI induction charges an arbitrary or minimum-influence split by C I_i without a justified selection hypothesis.
silent_when: The proof establishes a suitable chosen split, restricts the function class with exact separation hypotheses, or only states an entropy identity.
text: Check the split quantifier in FEI induction. Sparse flips of a bent function can have tiny selector influence and unbounded entropy charge. A bad coordinate refutes an every-coordinate estimate; it does not refute existence of a good split or global FEI.
